Garage description
A lumberjack's shirt represents strength and endurance to the hardships of manual labor. This paint borrows from that pattern to imbue the same values into the tank that wears it.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on February 6, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Lumberjack was worth 300,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Generalissimo.
Legacy paint description:
A paint with formidable protection against Firebird, Freeze and Isida. Slightly decreases damage dealt by Vulcan. An essential for any fan of close range combat. Makes your tank look like a tough woodcutter.
